label: Percentage
intent: The percent is struck. Light: the slash pulls up into its top end and strikes down between the two counters, stopping dead at the bottom; the top counter pops as the stroke passes it and the bottom one pops on the hit. Strong: the slash pulls up and hangs, then strikes harder; each counter is knocked away from the stroke as it pops bigger, rebounds and settles, top first. The counters stay round and open.

ring-a.x.//: Strong only: knocked away from the slash, along its normal (-0.83, -0.55)
